# DGP Construction LLC

> Finish carpentry and trim contractor based in Danbury, Connecticut. Licensed and insured. Serves homes within about 30 miles of Danbury, including Fairfield County, CT and Northern Westchester County, NY. Sends an itemized quote within 24 hours of receiving photos, measurements or blueprints.

DGP Construction specializes in the fine details of interior trim: tight miters and scarf joints, square door casings, plumb cabinet installs and woodwork that fits flush against the wall. Homeowners can request a quote through the website form, by text message or by email.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dgpconstructionusa.com/): services, recent work, frequently asked questions and the quote request form
- [Privacy Policy](https://dgpconstructionusa.com/privacy-policy.html): what information the website collects and how it is used
- [Terms of Use](https://dgpconstructionusa.com/terms-of-use.html): terms for using the website and requesting a quote

## Services

- Trim and finish carpentry: baseboards, window casing, door casing and crown molding
- Window installation and replacement
- Deck building
- Deck flooring replacement on sound existing frames
- Cabinet installation
- General interior remodeling

## Service area

Danbury, Bethel, Brookfield, New Fairfield, Ridgefield, Newtown, Redding, Wilton, New Milford, Brewster, Carmel, Katonah, Mount Kisco and other towns within about 30 miles of Danbury, Connecticut.

## How to get a quote

Send photos of the space, rough wall measurements or blueprints with a short description of the job. DGP Construction replies with an itemized quote within 24 hours. Customers who already bought trim, cabinets or decking can hire installation only.
